title: Days Supply Limits and Cost-Share Multiples by Home Delivery Pharmacy Program
content:
## Schedule of supply limits and cost-share multiples

This schedule sets, for each program of the Home Delivery Pharmacy (Northbridge Home Delivery Voluntary, Standard, Maintenance 90, Advantage, Maintenance Choice and Premier), how much medication one home delivery fill may carry and what multiple of the plan's 30-day cost share a home delivery supply is charged. The program in force is the one the member's current sponsor elected.

| | Voluntary | Standard | Maintenance 90 | Advantage | Maintenance Choice | Premier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Most days supply per home delivery fill | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 90 | 100 |
| Fewest days supply per fill of a maintenance drug | 30 | 30 | 60 | 30 | 60 | 30 |
| Multiple of the 30-day cost share for a 31-60 day supply | 2.0 | 2.0 | 2.0 | 2.0 | 2.0 | 1.5 |
| Multiple for a supply of 61 days or more, tier 1 | 3.0 | 2.5 | 2.0 | 2.0 | 2.0 | 1.5 |
| Multiple for a supply of 61 days or more, tier 2 | 3.0 | 2.5 | 2.5 | 2.0 | 2.0 | 2.0 |
| Multiple for a supply of 61 days or more, tier 3 | 3.0 | 3.0 | 2.5 | 2.5 | 2.5 | 2.0 |
| Tier 1 generics at zero member cost share (any deductible still applies where the plan applies it to tier 1) | No | No | No | No | No | Yes |
| Specialty-tier drugs dispensed by home delivery | No | No | No | No | No | No |
| Participating retail pharmacies may dispense a 61-90 day maintenance supply at the home delivery cost share | No | No | No | No | Yes | No |

### Notes to the schedule

1. The fewest-days figure applies to maintenance drugs; a shorter supply is dispensed only for a first fill or a dose titration.
2. The 61-day multiples apply from 61 days up to the program's most days supply per fill (100 days under Premier, 90 days under every other program).
3. Where specialty-tier drugs are not dispensed by home delivery, the member is referred to the specialty pharmacy program.

### Reading the schedule (hypothetical figures)

Suppose a plan's 30-day tier 2 cost share were 20.00 (an assumed figure, not a company rate). A 90-day tier 2 supply would then carry 3.0 times that share, 60.00, under Voluntary; 2.5 times, 50.00, under Standard or Maintenance 90; and 2.0 times, 40.00, under Advantage, Maintenance Choice or Premier. A 45-day supply of the same drug would carry 2.0 times the share, 40.00, under every program except Premier, where it would carry 1.5 times, 30.00.
